critical_code_review_comments: member_routes.claim_recruitment_purchase builds `update` with `$addToSet` and then overwrites it with `$addToSet: {entitlements, lead_ids}` — final code path is correct but the sequential rebuild is subtly fragile; consider merging into one dict up front to avoid confusion.

PurchaseSuccessPage: after login/register submit, if a paid-but-different offer_source purchase is claimed via the `submit` handler, the switch on `claimedNow` does not include `recruit_with_rooney_997` — it works because register/login return claimed='recruitment_self_guided', but the post-purchase auto-claim effect (which navigates to /module/1 on claimed_source==='recruit_with_rooney_997') is only fired if the buyer is ALREADY logged in when landing on /purchase/success. For the primary new-customer flow (register on the success page), routing to /app/recruitment/self-guided/module/1 works via the claimed==='recruitment_self_guided' branch — verified fine, but worth aligning the two branches for future-proofing.

accountability_service.process_engagement uses `datetime.fromisoformat(engagement['purchased_at'])` — assumes ISO-with-tz which the enroller writes. Any hand-inserted engagement without tz will be normalized (fallback in code). OK.
